article.hook: Everyone talks fast and flips ideas like cards. This moment asks you to slow down and hold one thought until it feels solid. Mercury in Taurus is the slow voice that weighs words before letting them go.
article.lived: For the next few weeks, your mind moves through ideas like hands sifting soil - searching for something that won’t crumble. Conversations drag on until you find the one sentence that sticks. You’ll notice how people lean in when you speak with quiet certainty, even if your pace feels out of sync with the rush around you.
article.turn: The risk is locking onto one idea so tightly you refuse to budge, even when the ground beneath it shifts. Stubborn opinions harden into walls, and silence replaces debate. When holding your ground turns into refusing to hear, you stop moving - and so does the conversation.
